bio: Indulge in one of the finest British traditions with our Laurent-Perrier Afternoon Tea experience at The Hansom.  Savour a selection of finely prepared sandwiches, signature scones and a delicious range of splendidly presented pastries and sweet delights. Together with 19 different varieties of loose-leaf tea to choose from, why not sip a glass of Laurent-Perrier Champagne to add some extra sparkle to the moment.  The elegant surrounding is complemented by live music on weekends, the perfect touch to ensure your Afternoon Tea at The Hansom is unforgettable.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 1:00pm to 5:00pm. Priced from £70 per person, or from £86 for a Champagne Afternoon Tea. Reserve your seat for Laurent-Perrier Afternoon Tea and savour an afternoon of unparalleled elegance.
